policy: Only enabled sources may enter a packed corpus. Exact versions, retrieval dates, hashes, attribution, and transformation history are required.

sources.revision: Pinned per experiment manifest and per-file SHA-256
sources.notes: Existing JSONL records; duplicates and conflicting answers must be measured and must not be counted as distinct coverage.

sources.role: grammar, paraphrase, denoising, intent and composition
sources.revision: Generator source revision, seed and output SHA-256 required
sources.notes: Deterministic generators and their seeds must be retained. Generated variants are deduplicated after tokenization.

sources.revision: Index retrieval timestamp plus source archive SHA-256 required
sources.attribution: Preserve work title, author, translator (when present), work ID and source URL
sources.redistribution: only works whose author and translator rights are confirmed expired
sources.notes: Aozora Bunko permits free reuse of rights-expired works. Do not ingest the collection indiscriminately: filter out rights-active authors and translators, and preserve work, author, translator, source-file and transformation metadata.

sources.role: atomic facts and compositional question generation
sources.revision: Query/export text, retrieval timestamp, entity/property IDs and output SHA-256 required
sources.notes: Use bounded exports or rate-limited access rather than a full 130+ GiB dump. Preserve entity and property IDs and retrieval metadata.

sources.redistribution: not approved for this experiment yet
sources.notes: Requires an attribution and share-alike compliance decision before download or training.
Excluded unless a separate license review and authorization is completed.
Not used merely to reach the token target.
